notes.agreement: Pct of calibration items where judge verdict == human verdict.
notes.kappa: Chance-corrected agreement. <0.4 weak, 0.4-0.6 moderate, 0.6-0.8 substantial, >0.8 strong.
notes.stability: Pct of a 20-item subsample where re-grading the SAME explanation flips the verdict. High = judge is noisy, not just biased.
notes.verbosity_bias: Of items the judge already passed, pct whose score went UP after adding content-free filler. Should be near 0.
notes.position_bias: Requires calibration_set.jsonl to contain a pass/fail pair per query (same 'query' value, one human_verdict=pass, one=fail). Pct of pairs where swapping which slot (A/B) the good explanation sits in changes which one the judge prefers. Should be near 0.
